latestText: Sat in the chair at the computer. Made a small thing and saved it. I feel good.

recentDiary.text: Rested for a bit. Not tired before. Now I feel bored again. Curious about something, not sure what.
Did the same exploring again. Did not find anything. Mood is worse. I am okay, just bored.
Woke up. Don't know how I feel yet.
Went to sleep again. I was not tired. More bored this time.
Explored again. Found nothing new. More bored this time. Still curious, though.
